name: Brusselator Cells
desc: An autocatalytic Brusselator reaction-diffusion medium whose chemistry breathes edge-to-edge — indigo-teal-yellow-red concentration cells that pulse as Turing spots, expand as target waves, and shear into oscillating stripe domains that never settle.

energy.doc: contrast/gain of the concentration ramp + glow amplitude

scale.doc: display zoom into the cell field

react.doc: reaction B toward the Hopf boundary (oscillation strength: calm patterns -> hot breathing)

density.doc: feature scale: few big cells (0) -> many small cells (1)

hue.doc: palette anchor hue (rotates the ramp; drives the contour lines)

act.doc: multi-minute program: breathing spots / concentric target rings / oscillating stripe domains

seed.doc: deterministic init + feed-phase field (rebuild on change)
